subject: Nanotechnology
title: Tandem Solar Cells
description: Learn Tandem Solar Cells in one minute.

hook.text: Stack two different absorbers and each catches a different part of the spectrum — tandem cells break 30% efficiency.

buildup.text: A perovskite top cell absorbs blue-green light while silicon below catches the red-infrared remainder.

discovery.text: Nano-textured interfaces between layers scatter and trap light — maximizing absorption in both sub-cells.

twist.text: Current matching between the two cells is critical — if one produces less, it limits the whole tandem.

climax.text: LONGi's perovskite-silicon tandem reached 33.9% in 2023 — the highest certified efficiency for any two-junction cell.

punchline.text: Two nano-thin layers capture what one layer alone would waste.

quiz.question: Why do tandem solar cells achieve higher efficiency?
options: They use twice as much silicon
Each layer absorbs a different part of the solar spectrum, reducing thermalization losses
